title: Color Savings and Strong Chromatic Index Bounds
exact_target: For a graph with maximum degree $\Delta$ and clique number $\omega$, how many colors can be saved in ordinary, list, or correspondence coloring relative to bounds from $\Delta$, $\omega$, and maximum average degree; in particular, is the strong chromatic index at most $1.25\Delta^2$?
